title: Bonds & Government Securities
intro: Government securities, tax-saving capital gains bonds, tax-free PSU bonds and corporate NCDs; compare post-tax yield, who backs the bond, how long your money is locked in and whether you can sell before maturity.
newsQuery: India bond yields G-Sec T-bill NCD
sources: RBI press release: 91/182/364-day T-bill auction cut-off, 30 Sep 2026 (prid=63694)
RBI press release: State Government Securities full auction result, 6 Oct 2026 (prid=63738)
Trading Economics: India 10-year G-Sec yield, 6 Oct 2026
FRSB 2020 (T) rate for Jul-Dec 2026 (Stable Investor / news, Jul 2026; RBI formula NSC + 0.35%)
GoldenPi NCD issue notes: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche V (Sep 2026), SMC Global Securities (Oct 2026)

params.label: Yield / coupon
params.tip: Latest auction cut-off yield, platform YTM or coupon (Sep-Oct 2026). Tax-free bond yields are post-tax, so compare with a taxable yield grossed up for your slab.

params.label: Tax treatment
params.tip: Income Tax Act 2025 applies from 1 Apr 2026; old section numbers shown where commonly used.

params.label: Credit rating
params.tip: Rating by CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings as shown on the issue or listing (Oct 2026).

params.label: Tenure / residual maturity
params.tip: Original tenure for new issues; approximate residual maturity for secondary-market bonds as of Oct 2026.

params.label: Listed / tradable
params.tip: Can be sold on an exchange or trading platform before maturity (liquidity varies).

params.label: Minimum investment
params.tip: Minimum ticket on issue or one bond at the listed price (Oct 2026).

items.name: RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds 2020 (Taxable)

v.tax: Fully taxable at slab; TDS applies

pros: Rate reset every six months at NSC rate + 0.35%; 8.05% for Jul-Dec 2026
cons: 7-year lock-in; early exit only for senior citizens (60+) after set periods
Rate falls if NSC rate is cut
items.best: Conservative savers in low tax slabs wanting a sovereign rate above FDs for 7 years.
items.news: RBI Floating Rate Savings Bonds interest rate

items.name: 10-year G-Sec (6.94% GS 2036) via RBI Retail Direct

v.tax: Interest taxable at slab; gains on sale taxed as capital gains

pros: Buy direct at auctions or on NDS-OM via RBI Retail Direct with no fees
cons: Price falls if interest rates rise
Retail secondary liquidity can be thin
items.best: Investors wanting a long-term sovereign yield and willing to hold through price swings.

items.name: 91-day Treasury Bill

v.freq: None (issued at discount, repaid at face value)

pros: Weekly auctions via RBI Retail Direct
items.best: Parking emergency or near-term money with zero credit risk.

items.name: 182-day Treasury Bill

v.freq: None (issued at discount, repaid at face value)

pros: Buy via RBI Retail Direct with no fees
cons: Return is all taxable at slab
items.best: Money needed in about six months.

items.name: 364-day Treasury Bill

v.freq: None (issued at discount, repaid at face value)

pros: Highest of the T-bill yields: 6.18% at 30 Sep 2026 auction
Simple FD-like alternative for one year
cons: Taxed at slab like an FD
Secondary market selling is less convenient than breaking an FD
items.best: A one-year, zero-credit-risk alternative to a bank FD.

items.name: Madhya Pradesh SDL 2036 (10-year)
pros: Weighted average yield 7.90% at 6 Oct 2026 auction
cons: Thinner secondary trading than central G-Secs
items.best: Long-term investors wanting near-sovereign safety with a higher yield than G-Secs.

items.name: Maharashtra SDL 2043 (17-year)
pros: Locks in about 7.99% for 17 years (6 Oct 2026 auction weighted average)
cons: Very long tenure; prices swing with rates
items.best: Retirement-style investors locking in a long-term state-backed yield.

items.name: REC 54EC Capital Gain Bonds

v.tax: Saves LTCG tax on land/building sale (Sec 54EC, now Sec 85) up to ₹50 lakh; interest taxable

pros: Exempts long-term capital gains on property sale if invested within 6 months
items.best: Property sellers wanting to save long-term capital gains tax.

items.name: PFC 54EC Capital Gain Bonds

v.tax: Saves LTCG tax on land/building sale (Sec 54EC, now Sec 85) up to ₹50 lakh; interest taxable

pros: Same capital gains exemption as REC
cons: ₹50 lakh combined cap across all 54EC bonds
items.best: Property sellers splitting 54EC investments across issuers.

items.name: IRFC 54EC Capital Gain Bonds

v.tax: Saves LTCG tax on land/building sale (Sec 54EC, now Sec 85) up to ₹50 lakh; interest taxable

pros: Same exemption and coupon as REC/PFC
items.best: Property sellers preferring a railway PSU for 54EC.

items.name: HUDCO 54EC Capital Gain Bonds

v.tax: Saves LTCG tax on land/building sale (Sec 54EC, now Sec 85) up to ₹50 lakh; interest taxable

pros: Same coupon and exemption as others

items.name: NHAI 7.35% Tax-Free Bond 2031

v.tax: Interest tax-free (old Sec 10(15)(iv)(h)); capital gains on sale taxable

cons: Trades at a premium, so yield is well below the coupon
Thin trading; may be hard to buy or sell
No new tax-free bonds since FY2015-16
items.best: Investors in the 30% slab wanting tax-free income until 2031.

items.name: IRFC 7.34% Tax-Free Bond 2028

v.tax: Interest tax-free; capital gains on sale taxable

cons: Bought at a premium to face value
Short tenure limits how long you lock the rate
items.best: High-slab investors needing tax-free income until early 2028.

items.name: IREDA 7.49% Tax-Free Bond 2031
items.provider: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd

v.tax: Interest tax-free; capital gains on sale taxable

pros: Locks in tax-free income until Jan 2031
items.best: 30%-slab investors wanting tax-free income for about four years.

items.name: HUDCO 7.51% Tax-Free Bond 2028

v.tax: Interest tax-free; capital gains on sale taxable

items.best: High-slab investors with a short horizon.

items.name: PFC 8.94% Bond Mar 2028
cons: High ticket of about ₹10.6 lakh per bond
Some credit risk versus sovereign bonds
items.best: Larger investors wanting a higher-yielding AAA PSU bond until 2028.

items.name: Muthoot Fincorp NCD (Tranche V, Sep 2026)

v.tax: Interest taxable at slab; TDS may apply

pros: Coupons 8.56%-9.25% across 2-6 year series; 9.25% for 72 months
Secured on loan receivables and gold assets
cons: Public issue closed 22 Sep 2026; now only in secondary market
Credit risk of a private NBFC
items.best: Investors accepting AA credit risk for about 9% over several years.

items.name: SMC Global Securities NCD (Oct 2026)

v.tax: Interest taxable at slab; TDS may apply

pros: Secured, to be listed on BSE
cons: Single-A rating means moderate credit risk
Company disclosed involvement in a 2026 CBI supplementary chargesheet (NSE co-location matter)
items.best: Investors seeking a higher yield who can accept meaningful credit risk.

items.name: Sovereign Gold Bonds (secondary market)

v.tax: 2.5% interest taxable; capital gains tax-free if held to maturity

pros: Gold price return plus 2.5% a year on the original issue price
No capital gains tax at redemption on maturity
cons: No new issues; only older series in the secondary market
Prices and liquidity vary by series
items.best: Gold investors who can hold to maturity; see the gold section for detail.
